answer: Each identity registers one falcon with a serial copper leg-band, nesting at an onyx cairn, locking an 80-credit bond. Each epoch the falcon molts one feather, filed by serial, molt index, and drop site. An auditor checks serial, index, site, and barbs against copper registry, sequence, onyx cairn, and falcon profile. Forged feather, skipped index, or reused serial burns the bond. First filing 41; the kth pays 41+6(k-1); the 1000th 6035. 1000 fakes pay 3,038,000 plus 80,000 locked. A rented-feather ring fails: one bird, one feather per window; an honest agent pays 41 once.
